name: Heavenly Pizzas
address: Impala Ave, Fraai Uitsig, Klein Brak River, 6503, South Africa
description_short: Family-run pizzeria in Glentana serving wood-fired pizzas with generous toppings and a laid-back coastal vibe.
description_long:
Tucked away in the peaceful Fraai Uitsig area of Klein Brak River, Heavenly Pizzas has built a loyal following among locals and holiday-makers alike. This friendly, family-run spot keeps things simple: quality wood-fired pizzas with generous toppings, made fresh to order in a relaxed setting.

The menu covers all the classics plus a few creative options, and the crust strikes that perfect balance between crispy and chewy. It's the kind of place where you can grab a pizza to take back to your accommodation or settle in for a casual meal. The service is warm and genuine, reflecting the family spirit behind the operation.

Located just off the main road between Mossel Bay and George, it's an easy stop whether you're passing through or staying in one of the nearby coastal villages. The laid-back atmosphere and honest, well-priced pizzas make it a reliable choice when you're craving something satisfying without the fuss.
